summary: Final record-linking update for the parent configuration question, with no new claim. Its account already says voter-adding changes, minority leadership and the post-heal disagreement are witnessed under the child question, but its execution set named only its own two receipts; this version adds the child's three decisive receipts (b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826 for the five-voter configuration loss, a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d for the post-heal log disagreement, 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3 as the two-second negative) alongside its own 75c355f2a4634b5193fa97e4de987fe0 and 3e2dd223dd5f43409c21066a1ca43175, keeps experiment_id on the parent's own experiment that owns the first cited receipt, and rescopes the parent's limitation so it no longer claims no divergence was witnessed in any execution — the child's eight-second observation is named as a disagreement at one index rather than a lost entry. All witness indices, control values, counterevidence and the parent's own witness are unchanged. Earlier in this turn an attempt to cite the child's experiment under the parent question was rejected by the semantic check, which correctly requires an interpretation's fixed experiment to belong to that investigation; that attempt is superseded by this one. State: four questions with complete violated comparisons and controls, one resolved gap, and knowledge entries covering the restart configuration loss, the blocked startup, the authority loss, minority leadership, acknowledged minority writes, the post-heal disagreement and the two-second durability negative.
